main.description: A public text post. Corrections, supplements, and endorsements are represented as new posts with extensions.

text.description: Human-readable text that remains useful without extension support. Do not normalize Unicode or line endings after signing.

exp.description: The author-specified absolute deadline for mesh delivery, distinct from information validity and deletion. Canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC, seconds precision).

created.description: Optional creation time with sub-second precision. Its seconds part must equal the Nostr created_at of the carrying event. Omit when seconds precision suffices.

ext.description: Optional author-signed extensions. Preserve each element's $type and unknown fields, array order, and multiple elements of the same type. Use an empty array when no extensions are present.
